lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, diffused circular clusters arranged in approximately five vertical columns posterior to the gills. The clusters exhibit a higher pixel intensity in the mid-flank and decrease in size and luminance toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like anchor node pattern across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges running along the upper third of the flank. Each is defined by a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadow values on the ventral edge.
